name: prompt-engineering
description: Turn a plain-language description into an optimized, concise LLM prompt, ready to paste into a Gemini Gem, Claude Project, or custom GPT, or to refine an existing one. Grounded in the 'Prompt Engineering in a Nutshell' knowledge base — promptingguide.ai, Google's Prompt Engineering whitepaper, and Anthropic's Claude prompting docs (elements of a prompt, role prompting, delimiters, few-shot, chain-of-thought, step-back, structured output, long-context ordering, context engineering) — with a bundled distilled reference so it works fully offline, and it uses the NotebookLM MCP for live source material when connected. Model-agnostic by design: named-Claude-model targets defer to the prompting-claude plugin when installed. Returns only the finished prompt (unless you ask for the rationale). Auto-engages via the 'prompt-engineering' skill whenever you write, generate, optimize, or refine a prompt or system prompt; slash-available as /prompt-engineering:prompt-engineering.
